experiments.name: Bounce: old $45k floor for everyone
experiments.why: 19 Oct the floor dropped to $25k for coins with 1,000+ holders and a $25k pool (PIERRE 26x, mucron 18x, MEGA 10x were all refused at $32-43k). This puts the old floor back. If this row says Helps, the new floor is losing money and should go.

experiments.name: Launch: wider stop (35%)
experiments.why: Launch buys the first leg of a fresh migration (19 Oct). First legs shake hard. Does a 35% stop keep more winners, or just lose more?

experiments.name: Launch: smaller crowds (300+ holders, top 10 under 45%)
experiments.why: Launch wants 500+ holders and top 10 under 35%. Are we too strict to catch them early?

experiments.name: Fresh coins: allow top 10 up to 45%
experiments.why: Nat's question from 18 Oct. Coins under 2h old currently need top 10 under 35%. Only testable on data from 18 Oct on, when the gate's results started being recorded.

experiments.name: Fresh coins: 100 holders instead of 150
experiments.why: Does the 150-holder minimum for coins under 2h keep us out of early winners?

experiments.name: Ride: tighter trails
experiments.why: A ride core peaked at +62.6% and trailed back to breakeven. Core trail 35% to 20%, sleeve 12% to 8%.

experiments.name: Ride: core trail starts at +15%
experiments.why: Same problem from the other side: arm the core trail earlier (default +25%) and a bit tighter (25%).

experiments.name: Trusted: double size
experiments.why: Wirelyss copies are winning but at $2 to $4 a trade they earn cents. What would 2x size have made, and lost?

experiments.name: Trusted: mcap ceiling $300k
experiments.why: We skip trusted buys above $150k mcap. Are we missing good copies?

experiments.name: Pullback: wider retrace window 15-50%
experiments.why: Live waits for a 20-40% retrace. Does a wider window find more winners or more losers?

experiments.name: Bounce: shallower dips from 25%
experiments.why: Live needs a 35% drop after migration before it looks for a bounce.

experiments.name: Dip: skip falling knives
experiments.why: Dip is paused because it kept buying dips that kept dipping. Skip any coin down more than 10% in the last hour.

experiments.name: Dip: the bounce needs real volume
experiments.why: Today a bounce counts on any green candle. Require 1.5x normal volume, so buyers are actually stepping in.

experiments.name: Dip: stronger bounce
experiments.why: Close at least 3% above the low (today 1%) on 1.5x volume.

experiments.name: Dip: shallow dips only (6-15%)
experiments.why: Deeper drops may be trend breaks, not dips. Only buy 6 to 15% off the 24h high (today up to 30%).

experiments.name: Dip: only the strongest setups
experiments.why: Raise dip's score bar from 55 to 70.

experiments.name: Dip: falling-knife filter plus stronger bounce
experiments.why: The two most likely fixes together.
